'''Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber''' was the weapon wielded by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] until [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when it was lost during a [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|duel]] with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Ep I" /><ref name="Guide" />

==Specifications==
A relatively simple design based upon his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi's weapon featured a solid hilt with the exception of the handgrip surrounding the main [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]].<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="CVD" /> 

The emitter barrel had all of the controls mounted onto it, which included the activator, blade length and intensity control, and blade power adjust, as well as the ridged housing for the blade modulation circuitry.<ref name="CVD" /> This was separated from the body of the weapon by a cut-back portion that held the internal [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|blade crystals]],<ref name="CVD" /> including a single focusing<ref name="Guide" /> blue [[Ilum crystal/Legends|Ilum crystal]].<ref name="LifeLegend" />

Immediately below was the main body with a scalloped handgrip, which thickened near the bottom of the section where the [[charging port]] was, concealed by the belt clip.<ref name="CVD" /> The pommel was a black sphere that housed the reserve power cell and cap, with six evenly spaced blocks projecting outward from its equator.<ref name="CVD" />

==History==

===Construction===
[[File:YoungObiWan-JA01.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Obi-Wan's lightsaber in its initial form, during his early apprenticeship.]]
Obi-Wan Kenobi created his first lightsaber as an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiate]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], crafting it with much thought and care beyond that required for mere competency in training exercises.<ref name="LifeLegend" /> He would subsequently use the weapon during his earliest missions as Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan learner,<ref name="LifeLegend" /> ultimately modelling the hilt after that of his master as a mark of respect.<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="CVD" /> Obi-Wan assured Qui-Gon, with a smile, that the [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]] protrusions on the hilt's pommel were to provide additional grip, and not simply because they looked good.<ref name="FactFile" /> 

At the age of thirteen, Obi-Wan made the customary pilgrimage to the snow-covered world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and harvested a blue [[Ilum crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] to energize his weapon.<ref name="LifeLegend" /> Following replacement of the saber's existing crystal, Obi-Wan felt that the blade seemed more precise and focused, with Qui-Gon commenting that some Jedi believed Ilum crystals improved one's connection with the Force.<ref name="LifeLegend" /> It was not until after this event, that Obi-Wan felt he had learned the true power of a lightsaber.<ref name="LifeLegend" />

===Battle of Naboo===

This lightsaber was at Obi-Wan's side during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and Kenobi used it to defend himself from several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] before being overwhelmed by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="Ep I" /> Later, in the swamplands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the weapon shorted out when it came in contact with the swamp's murky [[Water/Legends|water]] while he was under attack by a pair of [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]].<ref name="Ep I" />

[[File:DotF_TPM.png|thumb|right|225px|Obi-Wan Kenobi using his lightsaber to help Qui-Gon Jinn duel Darth Maul in Theed's hangar.]]
Upon receiving transport to Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], from the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], Kenobi and Jinn saved [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] from several battle droids. After traveling to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Kenobi returned to Naboo where a rebellion was planned against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] which had invaded their planet. In Theed, Jinn and Kenobi were confronted by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who [[Shiak|killed]] the elder Jedi in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|duel]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|forced]] the younger into a generator shaft with only a power node as a hand-hold. Although the Padawan's lightsaber was kicked down into the endless abyss, Kenobi was able to use his fallen master's [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|weapon]] to defeat his opponent.<ref name="Ep I" />

By [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="Jedi Quest 2">[[Jedi Quest 2|''Jedi Quest'' 2]]</ref> Obi-Wan would build a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|second lightsaber]] almost identical to the original weapon.<ref name="FactFile" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obi-Wan Kenobi's original lightsaber first appeared onscreen in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Ep I" /> 

After director [[George Lucas]] showed [[Ewan McGregor]], the actor who played Kenobi in the prequels, around the studio, they went to the props-making department, and the prop master showed him a chest of lightsaber hilts. McGregor then got to choose which lightsaber he would use in the film.<ref name="Return">''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]''</ref> The first lightsaber work he did was when he trained for the [[Lightsaber duel|duel]] against [[Darth]] Maul. He thought it was an amazing thing to be part of, and he found the duels to be very intricate and fast.<ref name="Series of Firsts">{{SWYouTube|ZHEDtlCcnrs|A Series of Firsts &#124; Obi-Wan Kenobi &#124; Disney+|sw_url=video/a-series-of-firsts-obi-wan-kenobi}}</ref>
